source: docs/papers/DSTU_9041-2020_Part of.pdf, document pages 30-33 (scan indices 28-31) - see docs/DECISIONS.md D-241
hash_function: Kupyna-256 (DSTU 7564:2014), truncated to l_H=64 bits from the LOW-order end, same as G.1/G.3
kalyna_kw_mode: Kalyna-256/256-KW-p (DSTU 7624 §15.4/15.5) - M' is 384 bits, not a multiple of the 256-bit block
private_key_e_note: Hex, as in G.1/G.3: the document prints 'e = 25'; 37*P equals the printed Q exactly.
kappa_note: kappa = the low-order 256 bits of x_T, big-endian - the document prints it; also the only candidate under which the printed t inverts to a valid KW checksum (D-241)
H_note: Printed exactly in the encryption and the decryption half; the printed M' line drops the '8D' in the middle (774E8653DD4732...), a printing slip - the decryption half prints the full M' correctly.
printed_t_note: Restored from C = r||t: the standalone t line drops a 'D' (CBDD0455 vs CBDDD0455 in both C copies) and every copy drops one '0' at hex position 208 (D3801D printed as D381D) - the only single-digit insertion under which the raw DSTU 7624 §15.3 inverse ends in the all-zero checksum block (4096 insertions x 5 kappa candidates tried, exactly one hit).
printed_t_discrepancy: DIVERGENCE (D-241): the document's t is Kalyna-256/256-KW over M' || 00*11 01 10 00*3 || 00*32, not DSTU 7624 §15.4's M' || mu_128(384) LE (80 01 00*14) || 80 00*31. The 16-byte field reads as 384 written in binary (110000000) and parsed as hex; the last block is zeros where B.2 puts the 1 bit. This crate follows the DSTU 7624 text (owner decision 2026-10-19), so it does not reproduce this t and rejects the document's C.
verified_checks: 37 * P == Q, 7 * P == R, 7 * Q == T - each matches the printed point exactly, both coordinates
r^2 mod p and the decryption half's recovered y (= p - y_R, the document notes the sign flip) match the printed values exactly
kappa equals the printed kappa exactly
Kupyna256(l_M~ || M~) low 8 bytes == the printed H exactly (scratch run of hazmat::kupyna::Kupyna256)
the decryption half's printed D(t) equals M' above
